Okay, lamb chop, pull up close, let Great Grandma Dot read you a story. This ain't the kind of story you're used to, mind you. Ain't no princesses or frog princes here. This is a story about… Tarkov. And these ain't just any keys, these are… special keys. To a special edition. *adjusts glasses on nose* Now, hush and listen.

(In a slow, slightly raspy voice, leaning in conspiratorially)

"**Edge of Darkness…** Mmm, sounds dangerous, don’t it? You have to say it low, see, like a secret.  Edddddge… of Darkness…  Now, inside this little box, this… Edition, is a whole heap of trouble. But good trouble, mind you. The kind that keeps you on your toes.

First, we got the **Guaranteed access to all subsequent DLCs (Season Pass).** *Sighs heavily.* Always chasing the new thing, ain't ya?  But you get it all, see? No extra pennies for you, good boy you are. The new lands, the new dangers... You get it ALL. Just like magic. *cackles softly*

Then, you get **Unique in-game ID.** A brand new tag, shiny and new for everyone to see you with! Be sure to find some friends to play with so they can look at your shiny label! I remember when I had my own shiny tag when I worked at that bakery!

Now, *shuffles papers a bit dramatically.*

**Secure container (gamma container) 3x3.**  Oh, this'll be handy.  Keeps somethin’ safe, that does.  Like when your grandpa tried to sneak a piece of cake before supper. This Container... keeps his secrets inside nice and safe. Hidden so no one can touch it!

**Increased stash size.** More room for your… "loot," you call it? I always said a bigger room needs more cleaning but for you sport that will be a happy chore! *Makes air quotes around "loot"* A good, big pantry filled with more than just stale bread and some beets. Imagine all the pickles you could store, now. Make sure you remember what you need and what you have to discard!

**Initially good standing with all in-game traders.** Good standing, eh?  Treat the traders right.  Politeness goes a long way, even in a rough town like Tarkov.  Just like I taught you to say please and thank you at the dinner table. Good mannered boys get taken care of.

And more, *flips paper.* Lots of little odds and ends to help ya along. Tools, ammo, fancy startin' equipment. Like when i made sure you had that nice blue blanket when you were little!

And the best thing, dear? **Priority support.** *Whispers.*  "When the world gets too rough, you have helpers."

(Lowers voice even further, almost a murmur)

Just remember, lamb chop, even in a place with "Edge of Darkness", There's still Good. There's still trust. There's still a need to help your neighbors, even when they're shooting at you.

Now close your eyes. Breeeathe deep. Think of all these treasures you'll uncover with those codes... Think of the stories you'll have to tell. And remember Great Grandma Dot loves you. Goodnight, little one. Sleep tight, and don't let the… Tarkov-mites… bite.”

(Makes a gentle shushing sound and a soft humming noise)
